title: High-precision quadrature via local Fourier extension: analytic integration, uniform sampling, and correction for piecewise smooth integrands
summary: We propose a high-precision numerical quadrature framework based on local Fourier extension (LFE) approximations. The method constructs, on each subinterval, a truncated-SVD stabilized local Fourier continuation of the integrand on an extended periodic domain, and then evaluates the integral \emph{analytically} from the resulting Fourier coefficients. Under uniform sampling, the discrete LFE matrix and its TSVD factors are precomputed once and reused across all windows, yielding an efficient offline/online implementation that remains compatible with classical composite rules.
